Blurb: The Republic of Venice loses parts of the Adriatic coast to the Ottoman Empire.

Title: Albanian League of Lezhe
Blurb: The Albanian League of Lezhe is annexed by the Ottoman Empire.

Title: Breadfield
Blurb: Battle of Breadfield, Matthias Corvinus of Hungary defeated the Turks.

Title: Adam's Bridge
Blurb: According to temple records, a cyclone destroys the land bridge (Adam's Bridge) connecting the Kingdom of Kandy in present-day Sri Lanka and Mainland India.

Title: Grand Duchy of Moscow
Blurb: After the Great standing on the Ugra river, Muscovy gained independence from the Great Horde.

Title: County of Provence
Blurb: France gains the County of Provence.

Title: Spain
Blurb: Spanish Inquisition begins in practice with the first auto-da-fe.

Title: Tenochtitlan
Blurb: Reign of Tizoc begins as the seventh tlatoani of Tenochtitlan and the emperor of the Aztec Triple Alliance.

Title: Burgundian Netherlands
Blurb: The Burgundian Netherlands are disestablished and become the Austrian Netherlands as part of the Habsburg monarchy.

Title: Congo
Blurb: Portuguese navigator Diogo Cao becomes the first European to enter the Congo.

Title: Duchy of Burgundy
Blurb: France gains the Duchy of Burgundy.

Title: Andalusia
Blurb: The Jews are expelled from Andalusia.

Title: London
Blurb: William Caxton, the first printer of books in English, prints his translation of Aesop's Fables in London.

Title: Adana
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire loses Adana to the Egyptians following their defeat against the Mamluk Sultanate in the Adana campaign.

Title: Astrakhan Khanate
Blurb: The Astrakhan Khanate splits from the Golden Horde.

Title: Becs
Blurb: King Matthias I moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom to Becs.

Title: Bosworth Field
Blurb: Henry VII defeats Richard III at the Battle of Bosworth and becomes King of England.

Title: Tver
Blurb: Ivan III of Russia conquered Tver.

Title: Vienna
Blurb: Matthias Corvinus of Hungary captured Vienna, Frederick III, Holy Roman Emperor ran away.

Title: Vijayanagara Empire
Blurb: Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya drives out Praudha Raya ending the Sangama Dynasty.

Title: Tenochtitlan
Blurb: Reign of Ahuitzotl begins as the eighth tlatoani of Tenochtitlan and emperor of the Aztec Triple Alliance.

Title: Ming China
Blurb: Hongzhi Emperor ascends the throne, bringing Confucian ideology under his administration.

Title: Cape of Good Hope
Blurb: Portuguese Navigator Bartolomeu Dias sails around the Cape of Good Hope.
Place: Cape of Good Hope, South Africa

Title: Kingdom of Cyprus
Blurb: The Kingdom of Cyprus falls to the Republic of Venice.

Title: Buda
Blurb: King Vladislaus II moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom back to Buda.

Title: China
Blurb: Although pioneered earlier in Korea and by the Chinese official Wang Zhen (with tin), bronze metal movable type printing is created in China by Hua Sui in 1490.

Title: Kingdom of Georgia
Blurb: The Kingdom of Georgia is divided into different parts.

Title: Emirate of Granada
Blurb: The combined forces of Castile and Aragon capture the Emirate of Granada, completing Spain's Reconquista.

Title: India
Blurb: Vasco da Gama discovers a sea route to India.

Title: Americas
Blurb: Arrival of Christopher Columbus to the Americas in 1492.

Title: Xamayca
Blurb: Christopher Columbus arrives at Xamayca.

Title: Inter caetera line
Blurb: Spanish Pope Alexander VI issues the papal bull Inter caetera granting to the Crowns of Castile and Aragon all newly discovered lands west of the meridian 100 leagues west of any of the islands of the Azores.

Title: Tordesillas
Blurb: Representatives of the Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the Treaty of Tordesillas, settling the countries' boundary of conquest in the Americas, Africa and Asia at a meridian 46 degrees 0 minutes west of Greenwich.

Title: Stuttgart
Blurb: The Duchy of Wurttemberg is established out of the County of Wurttemberg. Stuttgart remains the capital.

Title: Mozambique
Blurb: Vasco da Gama reaches Mozambique and takes possession of it for Portugal.

Title: Tierra Firme
Blurb: Spain creates the Province of Tierra Firme (Spanish Main) in the Americas.

Title: Tabriz
Blurb: The Safavids conquer Persia. Tabriz is the capital.

Title: Lepanto
Blurb: The Ottoman fleet of Kemal Reis defeats the Venetians at the Second Battle of Lepanto.

Title: Mombasa
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal conquers Mombasa.

Title: Brazil
Blurb: Portuguese navigator Pedro Alvares Cabral arrives at the coast of Brazil and claims all land in South America east of the Tordesillas Meridian for the Kingdom of Portugal, thus establishing the Portuguese Colony of Brazil.

Title: Ascension Island
Blurb: Joao da Nova discovers Ascension Island.

Title: Cannanore
Blurb: First Battle of Cannanore between the Third Portuguese Armada and Kingdom of Cochin under Joao da Nova and Zamorin of Kozhikode's navy marks the beginning of Portuguese conflicts in the Indian Ocean.

Title: Iran
Blurb: Safavid dynasty reunifies Iran and rules over it until 1736. Safavids adopt a Shia branch of Islam.

Title: Uzbek Khanate
Blurb: The Uzbek Khanate is disestablished.

Title: Wadai Sultanate
Blurb: The Wadai Sultanate is established.

Title: Golden Horde
Blurb: The Golden Horde is disestablished following the death of Shaykh Ahmad.

Title: New World
Blurb: First reported African slaves in the New World.

Title: Sarai
Blurb: The Crimean Khanate sacks Sarai in the Golden Horde, ending its existence.

Title: Cerignola
Blurb: Spain defeats France at the Battle of Cerignola. Considered to be the first battle in history won by gunpowder small arms.

Title: Kutaraja
Blurb: The Aceh Sultanate is established. Kutaraja is the capital.

Title: Crown of Castile
Blurb: Death of Isabella I of Castile; Joanna of Castile becomes the Queen.

Title: Kingdom of Naples
Blurb: The Kingdom of Naples is ceded to the Crown of Aragon.

Title: Spain
Blurb: A period of drought, with famine in all of Spain.

Title: Sultanate of Sennar
Blurb: Foundation of the Sultanate of Sennar by Amara Dunqas, in what is modern Sudan.

Title: Kochi
Blurb: The colony of Portuguese India is established. Kochi is the capital.

Title: Ming China
Blurb: Zhengde Emperor ascends the throne of Ming dynasty.

Title: Sultanate of Demak
Blurb: Sultan Trenggono builds the first Muslim kingdom in Java, called Demak, in Indonesia. Many other small kingdoms were established in other islands to fight against Portuguese.

Title: Erfurt
Blurb: Martin Luther enters St. Augustine's Monastery at Erfurt, Germany, on 17 July and begins his journey to instigating the Reformation.

Title: Agra
Blurb: The Delhi Sultanate moves its capital from Delhi to Agra.

Title: Lisbon
Blurb: At least two thousand converted Jews are massacred in a Lisbon riot, Portugal.

Title: Mbanza Kongo
Blurb: King Afonso I of Kongo wins the battle of Mbanza Kongo, resulting in Catholicism becoming Kongo's state religion.

Title: Poland
Blurb: Poland is invaded by Tatars from the Crimean Khanate.

Title: Samarkand
Blurb: Fall of the Timurid Empire. The Khanate of Bukhara is created from areas of the former empire. Samarkand is the capital.

Title: Hispaniola
Blurb: The first recorded epidemic of smallpox in the New World on the island of Hispaniola. It devastates the native Taino population.

Title: Hormuz and Muscat
Blurb: Afonso de Albuquerque conquered Hormuz and Muscat, among other bases in the Persian Gulf, taking control of the region at the entrance of the Gulf.

Title: Socotra
Blurb: The Portuguese Empire captures the island of Socotra from the Mahra Sultanate with a fleet of 14 ships in the Battle of Socotra. The colony Portuguese Socotra is established and Suq is its capital.

Title: Chaul
Blurb: The Christian-Islamic power struggle in Europe and West Asia spills over into the Indian Ocean as Battle of Chaul during the Portuguese-Mamluk War.

Title: Diu
Blurb: The defeat of joint fleet of the Sultan of Gujarat, the Mamluk Burji Sultanate of Egypt, and the Zamorin of Calicut with support of the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire in Battle of Diu marks the beginning of Portuguese dominance of the Spice trade and the Indian Ocean.

Title: Malacca
Blurb: Portugal sends Diogo Lopes de Sequeira to find Malacca, the eastern terminus of Asian trade. After first receiving him, Sultan Mahmud Shah seizes several of his men and attacks his four ships, which escape. The Javanese fleet at Malacca is also destroyed.

Title: Tudor England
Blurb: The 'great plague' in various parts of Tudor England, lasting into 1510.

Title: Vijayanagara Empire
Blurb: Krishnadevaraya ascends the throne of Vijayanagara Empire.

Title: Goa
Blurb: Afonso de Albuquerque of Portugal conquers Goa in India.

Title: Pskov Republic
Blurb: The Grand Duchy of Moscow annexes the Pskov Republic.

Title: Old Urgench
Blurb: The Khanate of Khiva is established in Central Asia. Old Urgench is the capital.

Title: Socotra
Blurb: Portuguese Socotra is abandoned and the Mahra Sultanate retakes control of the island of Socotra.

Title: Golconda Sultanate
Blurb: Qutb Shahi dynasty, founded by Quli Qutb Mulk, rules Golconda Sultanate until 1687.

Title: Maluku Islands
Blurb: The first Portuguese exploratory expedition was sent eastward from Malacca to search for the Spice Islands (Maluku) led by Francisco Serrao. Serrao is shipwrecked but struggles on to Hitu (northern Ambon) and wins the favour of the local rulers.

Title: Anatolia
Blurb: Sultan Selim I (The Grim) orders the massacre of Shia Muslims in Anatolia (present-day Turkey).

Title: Battle of the Spurs
Blurb: Henry VIII defeats the French at the Battle of the Spurs.

Title: Flodden Field
Blurb: The Battle of Flodden Field in which invading Scots are defeated by Henry VIII's forces.

Title: Florida
Blurb: Juan Ponce de Leon claims Florida for Spain.

Title: Macau
Blurb: The Portuguese mariner Jorge Alvares lands at Macau, China, during the Ming dynasty.

Title: Pacific Ocean
Blurb: Vasco Nunez de Balboa, in service of Spain arrives at the Pacific Ocean (which he called Mar del Sur) across the Isthmus of Panama. He was the first European to do so.

Title: Chaldiran
Blurb: The Battle of Chaldiran, the Ottoman Empire gains decisive victory against Safavid dynasty.

Title: Kingdom of Hungary
Blurb: Dozsa rebellion (peasant revolt) in Hungary.

Title: Orsha
Blurb: The Battle of Orsha halts Muscovy's expansion into Eastern Europe.

Title: Principality of Moldavia
Blurb: The Principality of Moldavia becomes a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire.

Title: Dulkadirs and Ramadanids
Blurb: The Ottomans conquer the last beyliks of Anatolia, the Dulkadirs and the Ramadanids.

Title: Eastern Anatolia
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire wrests Eastern Anatolia from the Safavids after the Battle of Chaldiran.

Title: Kingdom of France
Blurb: Ascension of Francis I of France as King of France following the death of Louis XII.

Title: Regency of Algiers
Blurb: Algeria becomes a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire as the Regency of Algiers.

Title: Egypt, Arabia and the Levant
Blurb: The Ottomans defeat the Mamluks and gain control of Egypt, Arabia, and the Levant, in campaigns lasting into 1517.

Title: Majapahit Empire
Blurb: Fall of the Majapahit Empire in Indonesia.

Title: Saxony
Blurb: The Reformation begins when Martin Luther posts his Ninety-five Theses in Saxony.

Title: Tudor England
Blurb: The Sweating sickness epidemic in Tudor England.

Title: London
Blurb: The Treaty of London, a non-aggression pact among the major European powers. Signatories Burgundy, France, England, the Holy Roman Empire, the Netherlands, the Papal States and Spain agree not to attack one another and to aid any that is attacked.

Title: Punjab
Blurb: Mir Chakar Khan Rind leaves Baluchistan and settles in Punjab.

Title: Strasbourg
Blurb: The dancing plague of 1518 begins in Strasbourg, lasting for about one month.

Title: Algiers
Blurb: Barbary pirates led by Hayreddin Barbarossa, a Turk appointed to ruling position in Algiers by the Ottoman Empire, raid Provence and Toulon in southern France.

Title: Aztec Empire
Blurb: Hernan Cortes leads the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire, from 1519 to 1521.

Title: Circumnavigation of the Earth
Blurb: Spanish expedition commanded by Magellan and Elcano are the first to circumnavigate the Earth, from 1519 to 1522.

Title: Holy Roman Empire
Blurb: Death of Emperor Maximilian; Charles I of Austria, Spain, and the Low Countries becomes Emperor of Holy Roman Empire as Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor (ruled until 1556).

Title: Aceh Sultanate
Blurb: Sultan Ali Mughayat Shah of Aceh begins an expansionist campaign capturing Daya on the west Sumatran coast, and the pepper and gold producing lands on the east coast.

Title: Lamakera, Solor
Blurb: The Portuguese established a trading post in the village of Lamakera on the eastern side of Solor as a transit harbour between Maluku and Malacca.

Title: Ottoman Empire
Blurb: The reign of Suleiman the Magnificent marks the zenith of the Ottoman Empire, from 1520 to 1566.

Title: Raichur
Blurb: Vijayanagara Empire forces under Krishnadevaraya defeat the Adil Shahi at the Battle of Raichur.

Title: Sultanate of Maguindanao
Blurb: The Sultanate of Maguindanao is established.

Title: Ethiopia
Blurb: The first European diplomatic mission to Ethiopia, sent by the Portuguese, arrives at Massawa 9 April, and reaches the imperial encampment of Emperor Dawit II in Shewa 9 October.

Title: Bahrain
Blurb: A combined Portuguese-Hormuz force under Antonio Correia conquers Bahrain but briefly loses it to the princes of Al-Hasa the same year. Portugal sends a second expedition to Bahrain and the Arabian coast to subdue Al-Hasa and end their attempts to regain power.

Title: Belgrade
Blurb: Belgrade (in present-day Serbia) is captured by the Ottoman Empire.

Title: Malacca
Blurb: Pati Unus leads the invasion of Malacca against the Portuguese occupation. Pati Unus was killed in this battle, and was succeeded by his brother, sultan Trenggana.

Title: Ming China
Blurb: Jiajing Emperor ascended the throne of Ming dynasty, China.

Title: Philippines
Blurb: Philippines encountered by Ferdinand Magellan. He was later killed in the Battle of Mactan in central Philippines in the same year.

Title: Sitawaka
Blurb: Mayadunne establishes the Kingdom of Sitawaka in Sri Lanka from the Sinhala Kingdom at Kotte. Sitawaka is the capital.

Title: Tuen Mun
Blurb: After building fortifications at Tuen Mun, the Portuguese attempt to invade Ming dynasty China, but are expelled by Chinese naval forces.

Title: Tenochtitlan
Blurb: The combined forces of Hernan Cortes conquer Tenochtitlan, capital of the Aztec Empire. The Kingdom of Spain subsequently renames the region Viceroyalty of New Spain. The destroyed capital is rebuilt and renamed Mexico.

Title: Maluku Islands
Blurb: Ferdinand Magellan's expedition reaches Maluku and after trade with Ternate returns to Europe with a load of cloves.

Title: Rhodes
Blurb: Rhodes falls to the Ottomans of Suleiman the Magnificent.

Title: Ternate
Blurb: The Portuguese ally themselves with the rulers of Ternate and begin construction of a fort.

Title: Sunda Kelapa
Blurb: Luso-Sundanese Treaty signed between Portugal and Sunda Kingdom granted Portuguese permit to build a fortress in Sunda Kelapa.

Title: Kalmar Union
Blurb: The Kalmar Union is dissolved.

Title: Atlantic coast of North America
Blurb: Giovanni da Verrazzano is the first European to explore the Atlantic coast of North America between South Carolina and Newfoundland.

Title: Holy Roman Empire
Blurb: German Peasants' War in the Holy Roman Empire, from 1524 to 1525.

Title: Safavid Iran
Blurb: Ismail I, the founder of Safavid dynasty, dies and Tahmasp I becomes king.

Title: Panipat
Blurb: Timurid Empire forces under Babur defeat the Lodi dynasty at the First Battle of Panipat, end of the Delhi Sultanate.

Title: Pavia
Blurb: German and Spanish forces defeat France at the Battle of Pavia, Francis I of France is captured.

Title: Livonian Order
Blurb: The Teutonic Order relinquishes its rights over its autonomous Livonian Order.

Title: Konigsberg
Blurb: The Duchy of Prussia emerges from the State of the Teutonic Order. Konigsberg is the capital.

Title: Agra
Blurb: Babur defeats the sultan of Delhi, establishing the Mughal Empire. Agra is the capital.

Title: Habsburg monarchy
Blurb: Archduke Ferdinand of Austria is elected the next King of Bohemia and Hungary following the death of Louis II of Hungary and Bohemia, ruling the lands which would come to be known as the Habsburg monarchy.

Title: Hungary and Croatia
Blurb: After the Battle of Mohacs, large parts of Hungary and Croatia fall to the Ottoman Empire.

Title: Bahmani Sultanate
Blurb: The Bahmani Sultanate is dissolved.

Title: Mac dynasty
Blurb: Thai To establishes the Mac dynasty in Vietnam.

Title: Majapahit
Blurb: The last ruler of Majapahit falls from power and the state is extinguished by Demak. Many courtiers, artisans, priests and royals move east to Bali, while power and the seat of government pass to Demak under Pangeran, later Sultan Fatah.

Title: Rome
Blurb: Sack of Rome with Pope Clement VII escaping and the Swiss Guards defending the Vatican being killed. The sack of the city of Rome considered the end of the Italian Renaissance.

Title: Sweden
Blurb: Protestant Reformation begins in Sweden.

Title: Zagreb
Blurb: The Kingdom of Croatia is established as part of the Habsburg monarchy. Zagreb is the capital.

Title: Jayakarta
Blurb: Prince Fatahillah of the Cirebon Sultanate defeats Portuguese forces at Sunda Kelapa Harbor. The city is renamed Jayakarta, meaning glorious victory; the day is recognised as Jakarta's founding anniversary.

Title: Detmold
Blurb: The County of Lippe is established from the Lordship of Lippe. Detmold is the capital.

Title: Moluccas and Philippines
Blurb: Treaty of Zaragoza defined the antimeridian of Tordesillas attributing the Moluccas to Portugal and Philippines to Spain.

Title: Shimbra Kure
Blurb: Imam Ahmad Gurey defeats the Ethiopian Emperor Dawit II in the Battle of Shimbra Kure, the opening clash of the Ethiopian-Adal War.

Title: Vienna
Blurb: The Austrians defeat the Ottoman Empire at the siege of Vienna.

Title: New Castile and New Toledo
Blurb: Spain creates the Governorate of New Castile and New Toledo in South America with the Capitulation of Toledo.

Title: Mantua
Blurb: The Duchy of Mantua is established in northern Italy. Mantua is the capital.

Title: Birgu
Blurb: The Order of Saint John annexes Malta and moves the capital from Mdina to Birgu.

Title: Church of England
Blurb: The Church of England breaks away from the Catholic Church and recognizes King Henry VIII as the head of the Church, from 1531 to 1532.

Title: Inca Empire
Blurb: The Inca Civil War is fought between the two brothers, Atahualpa and Huascar.

Title: Duchy of Brittany
Blurb: The Kingdom of France annexes the Duchy of Brittany.

Title: Florence
Blurb: The Duchy of Florence replaces the Republic of Florence. Florence remains the capital.

Title: Inca Empire
Blurb: Francisco Pizarro leads the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire.

Title: Sao Vicente
Blurb: Foundation of Sao Vicente, the first permanent Portuguese settlement in the Americas.

Title: Later Le dynasty
Blurb: The Later Le dynasty in Vietnam is restored under Trang Tong.

Title: Cuzco
Blurb: Francisco Pizarro leads an army into Cuzco, completing the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire.

Title: Baghdad
Blurb: The Ottomans capture Baghdad from the Safavids.

Title: Canada
Blurb: Jacques Cartier claims Canada for France.

Title: Colony of Brazil
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal divides its Colony of Brazil into 15 independent captaincies.

Title: Kingdom of France
Blurb: Affair of the Placards, where King Francis I becomes more active in repression of French Protestants.

Title: New Andalusia and New Leon
Blurb: Spain creates via capitulations the Governorate of New Andalusia and New Leon in South America.

Title: New France
Blurb: The colony of New France is established in North America.

Title: Munster
Blurb: The Munster Rebellion, an attempt of radical, millennialist, Anabaptists to establish a theocracy, ends in bloodshed.

Title: Ternate
Blurb: The Portuguese in Ternate depose Sultan Tabariji and send him to Portuguese Goa where he converts to Christianity and bequeaths his Portuguese godfather Jordao de Freitas the island of Ambon. Hairun becomes the next sultan.

Title: Buenos Aires
Blurb: Foundation of Buenos Aires (in present-day Argentina) by Pedro de Mendoza.

Title: Portugal
Blurb: Establishment of the Inquisition in Portugal.

Title: Pozsony
Blurb: King Ferdinand I moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom to Pozsony.

Title: Denmark-Norway
Blurb: Denmark-Norway emerges as a dual monarchy after the withdrawal of the Kingdom of Sweden from the Kalmar Union.

Title: Recife
Blurb: The Portuguese establish Recife in Pernambuco, north-east of Brazil.

Title: Bogota
Blurb: Gonzalo Jimenez de Quesada founds Bogota.

Title: Preveza
Blurb: Spanish-Venetian fleet is defeated by the Ottoman Turks at the Battle of Preveza.

Title: Inland North America
Blurb: Hernando de Soto explores inland North America.

Title: Terra Australis
Blurb: Spain claims the territories to the south of the Strait of Magellan creating the Governorate of Terra Australis.

Title: Sasaram
Blurb: Sher Shah Suri establishes the Sur Empire, which dominates northern India and follows the Mughal Empire. Sasaram is the capital.

Title: Society of Jesus
Blurb: The Society of Jesus, or the Jesuits, is founded by Ignatius of Loyola and six companions with the approval of Pope Paul III.

Title: Suri Empire
Blurb: Sher Shah Suri, an ethnic Pashtun of the house of Sur, decisively defeats Humayun at the Battle of Bilgram and founds the Suri dynasty, supplanting the Mughals as rulers of North India under the ineffectual second Mughal emperor.

Title: Algiers
Blurb: An Algerian military campaign by Charles V of Spain (Habsburg) is unsuccessful.

Title: Amazon River
Blurb: Amazon River is encountered and explored by Francisco de Orellana.

Title: Buda
Blurb: Capture of Buda and the absorption of the major part of Hungary by the Ottoman Empire.

Title: Russia
Blurb: Sahib I Giray of Crimea invades Russia.

Title: Italy
Blurb: The Italian War of 1542-1546 resumes between Francis I of France and Emperor Charles V. This time Henry VIII is allied with the Emperor, while James V of Scotland and Sultan Suleiman I are allied with the French.

Title: Las Islas Filipinas
Blurb: Spanish explorer Ruy Lopez de Villalobos named the island of Samar and Leyte Las Islas Filipinas honoring Philip II of Spain and became the official name of the archipelago.

Title: Principality of Wales
Blurb: The Kingdom of England annexes the Principality of Wales.

Title: Viceroyalty of Peru
Blurb: The Viceroyalty of Peru is established as an overseas territory of Spain.

Title: Japan
Blurb: The Nanban trade period begins after Portuguese traders make contact with Japan.

Title: Wayna Daga
Blurb: Ethiopian and Portuguese troops defeat the Adal army led by Imam Ahmad Gurey at the Battle of Wayna Daga; Imam Ahmad Gurey is killed at this battle.

Title: Ceresole
Blurb: The French defeat an Imperial-Spanish army at the Battle of Ceresole.

Title: Scotland
Blurb: Battle of the Shirts in Scotland. The Frasers and Macdonalds of Clan Ranald fight over a disputed chiefship; reportedly, 5 Frasers and 8 Macdonalds survive.

Title: Niani
Blurb: Songhai forces sack the Malian capital of Niani.

Title: Northern Vietnam
Blurb: The Trinh lords establish de facto control over northern Vietnam.

Title: Parma
Blurb: The Duchy of Parma is established from parts of the Duchy of Milan.

Title: Trent
Blurb: The Council of Trent meets for the first time in Trent (in northern Italy).

Title: Ambon, Ternate and Morotai
Blurb: Francis Xavier works among the peoples of Ambon, Ternate and Morotai laying the foundations for a permanent mission, until 1547.

Title: Moscow
Blurb: Ivan the Terrible proclaims the Tsardom of Russia, which follows the Grand Duchy of Moscow. Moscow is the capital.

Title: Muhlberg
Blurb: Emperor Charles V decisively dismantles the Schmalkaldic League at the Battle of Muhlberg.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: Edward VI becomes King of England and Ireland on 28 January and is crowned on 20 February at the age of 9.

Title: County of Stolberg
Blurb: The County of Stolberg is divided into Stolberg-Stolberg and Stolberg-Rochefort.

Title: Ming China
Blurb: The Ming dynasty government of China issues a decree banning all foreign trade and closes down all seaports along the coast; these Hai jin laws came during the Wokou wars with Japanese pirates.

Title: Timbuktu
Blurb: Askia Daoud, who reigned from 1548 to 1583, establishes public libraries in Timbuktu (in present-day Mali).

Title: Uedahara
Blurb: Battle of Uedahara: Firearms are used for the first time on the battlefield in Japan, and Takeda Shingen is defeated by Murakami Yoshikiyo.

Title: Salvador
Blurb: Tome de Sousa establishes Salvador in Bahia, north-east of Brazil.

Title: Taroudant
Blurb: The Saadi dynasty is established in Morocco. Taroudant is the capital.

Title: Beijing
Blurb: Mongols led by Altan Khan invade China and besiege Beijing.

Title: Suleymaniye Mosque
Blurb: The architect Mimar Sinan builds the Suleymaniye Mosque in Istanbul.

Title: Valladolid
Blurb: Valladolid debate concerning the human rights of the Indigenous people of the Americas, from 1550 to 1551.

Title: England
Blurb: Fifth outbreak of sweating sickness in England. John Caius of Shrewsbury writes the first full contemporary account of the symptoms of the disease.

Title: Gozo
Blurb: North African pirates enslave the entire population of the Maltese island Gozo, between 5,000 and 6,000, sending them to Libya.

Title: Muscat
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire conquers Muscat from Portugal.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: Mary Tudor becomes the first queen regnant of England and restores the Church of England under Papal authority.

Title: Macau
Blurb: The Portuguese found a settlement at Macau.

Title: Sao Paulo
Blurb: Missionaries Jose de Anchieta and Manuel da Nobrega establishes Sao Paulo, southeast Brazil.

Title: Wattasid dynasty
Blurb: Fall of the Wattasid dynasty in Morocco.

Title: Muscovy Company
Blurb: The Muscovy Company is the first major English joint stock trading company.

Title: Qazvin
Blurb: The Safavids in Persia move their capital from Tabriz to Qazvin.

Title: Republic of Siena
Blurb: The Republic of Siena is conquered by the Kingdom of Spain and most of it is granted to the Duchy of Florence. The Stato dei Presidi remain with Spain.

Title: Astrakhan Khanate
Blurb: Russia conquers the Astrakhan Khanate.

Title: Delhi
Blurb: Mir Chakar Khan Rind captures Delhi with Humayun.

Title: Mughal Empire
Blurb: During his reign, Akbar expands the Mughal Empire in a series of conquests in the Indian subcontinent, from 1556 to 1605.

Title: Panipat
Blurb: Akbar defeats Hemu at the Second battle of Panipat.

Title: Shaanxi
Blurb: The Shaanxi earthquake in China is history's deadliest known earthquake during the Ming dynasty.

Title: Sur Empire
Blurb: The Sur Empire is annexed by the restored Mughal Empire.

Title: Habsburg Spain
Blurb: Habsburg Spain declares bankruptcy. Philip II of Spain had to declare four state bankruptcies in 1557, 1560, 1575 and 1596.

Title: Macau
Blurb: The Portuguese settle in Macau, on the western side of the Pearl River Delta across from present-day Hong Kong.

Title: Massawa
Blurb: The Ottomans capture Massawa, all but isolating Ethiopia from the rest of the world.

Title: Central and southern Vietnam
Blurb: The Nguyen lords establish de facto control over central and southern Vietnam.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: Elizabeth Tudor becomes Queen Elizabeth I at age 25.

Title: Livonia
Blurb: Livonian War between Poland, Grand Principality of Lithuania, Sweden, Denmark and Russia, from 1558 to 1583.

Title: Bishopric of Dorpat
Blurb: Russia conquers the Bishopric of Dorpat in Estonia.

Title: Cateau-Cambresis
Blurb: With the Peace of Cateau Cambresis, the Italian Wars conclude.

Title: Gorkha
Blurb: The Kingdom of Gorkha is founded. Gorkha is the capital.

Title: Kangaba
Blurb: The Mali Empire moves its capital from Niani to Kangaba.

Title: Ternate
Blurb: Sultan Hairun of Ternate protests the Portuguese's Christianisation activities in his lands. Hostilities between Ternate and the Portuguese.

Title: Bishopric of Osel-Wiek
Blurb: The Bishopric of Osel-Wiek in Western Estonia is sold to Denmark.

Title: Djerba
Blurb: Ottoman navy defeats the Spanish fleet at the Battle of Djerba.

Title: Kingdom of Navarre
Blurb: Jeanne d'Albret declares Calvinism the official religion of Navarre.

Title: Okehazama
Blurb: By winning the Battle of Okehazama, Oda Nobunaga becomes one of the pre-eminent warlords of Japan.

Title: Vientiane
Blurb: Lan Xang in Laos moves its capital from Luang Prabang to Vientiane.

Title: Bishopric of Courland
Blurb: The Bishopric of Courland in Western Latvia is sold to Denmark.

Title: Kawanakajima
Blurb: The fourth battle of Kawanakajima between the Uesugi and Takeda at Hachimanbara takes place.

Title: Harrien-Wierland and Jerwen
Blurb: The northern Livonian Order regions of Harrien-Wierland (without Reval) and Jerwen pledge allegiance to Sweden.

Title: Reval
Blurb: The northern Livonian Order town Reval pledges allegiance to Sweden.

Title: Livonia
Blurb: The Treaty of Vilnius dissolves the Livonian Order, effective 5 March 1562: part becomes the Principality of Livonia in personal union with Lithuania, part the Lithuanian vassal Duchy of Courland and Semigallia. Riga becomes a free imperial city.

Title: France
Blurb: French Wars of Religion between Catholics and Huguenots, from 1562 to 1598.

Title: Mughal Empire
Blurb: Mughal emperor Akbar reconciles the Muslim and Hindu factions by marrying into the powerful Rajput Hindu caste.

Title: Turin
Blurb: Turin replaces Chambery as capital of the Duchy of Savoy.

Title: Wassy and Dreux
Blurb: Massacre of Wassy and Battle of Dreux in the French Wars of Religion.

Title: Elizabethan England
Blurb: Plague outbreak claimed 80,000 people in Elizabethan England. In London alone, over 20,000 people died of the disease.

Title: Wiek and Dago
Blurb: Sweden conquers from Denmark the former areas of the Bishopric of Osel-Wiek in Wiek and Dago, leaving Denmark only with its possessions in Osel.

Title: West Estonian archipelago
Blurb: The Bailiff of Soneburg of the former Livonian Order, now the Principality of Livonia, sells its bailiwick in the West Estonian archipelago to the Danish-controlled Bishopric of Osel-Wiek. Denmark cedes its nominal rights over Wiek to Livonia in return.

Title: Malta
Blurb: The Hospitallers, a Crusading Order, defeat the Ottoman Empire at the siege of Malta.

Title: Pacific Ocean
Blurb: Spanish navigator Andres de Urdaneta discovers the maritime route from Asia to the Americas across the Pacific Ocean, also known as the tornaviaje.

Title: Rio de Janeiro
Blurb: Estacio de Sa establishes Rio de Janeiro in Brazil.

Title: Royal Exchange
Blurb: Royal Exchange is founded by Thomas Gresham.

Title: Talikota
Blurb: Deccan sultanates defeat the Vijayanagara Empire at the Battle of Talikota.

Title: Netherlands
Blurb: Eighty Years' War between Spain and the Netherlands, from 1566 to 1648.

Title: Szigetvar
Blurb: Suleiman the Magnificent, ruler of the Ottoman Empire, dies on September 7, during the battle of Szigetvar.

Title: Duchy of Livonia
Blurb: The Union of Grodno turns the personal union between the Principality of Livonia and Grand Duchy of Lithuania into a real union and the former is reorganized as the Duchy of Livonia. The Lithuanian vassal state Archbishopric of Riga is annexed to the Duchy of Livonia.

Title: Kingdom of Scotland
Blurb: Mary, Queen of Scots, is imprisoned by Elizabeth I.

Title: Ming China
Blurb: After 45 years' reign, Jiajing Emperor died in the Forbidden City, Longqing Emperor ascended the throne of Ming dynasty.

Title: Japan
Blurb: The Azuchi-Momoyama period in Japan, from 1568 to 1600.

Title: Spain
Blurb: Morisco Revolt in Spain, from 1568 to 1571.

Title: Torda
Blurb: The Transylvanian Diet, under Prince John Sigismund Zapolya and inspired by Ferenc David, founder of the Unitarian Church of Transylvania, promulgates the Edict of Torda, the first law of freedom of religion and conscience in the world.

Title: England
Blurb: Rising of the North in England.

Title: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth
Blurb: The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth is created with the Union of Lublin, which lasts until 1795.

Title: Ternate
Blurb: Peace treaty signed by Sultan Hairun of Ternate and Governor Lopez de Mesquita of Portugal.

Title: Grand Duchy of Tuscany
Blurb: The Grand Duchy of Tuscany is established from the Duchy of Florence. Florence remains the capital.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: Pope Pius V issues Regnans in Excelsis, a papal bull excommunicating all who obeyed Elizabeth I and calling on all Catholics to rebel against her.

Title: Nicosia
Blurb: 20,000 inhabitants of Nicosia in Cyprus were massacred and every church, public building, and palace was looted. Cyprus fell to the Ottoman Turks the following year.

Title: Novgorod
Blurb: Ivan the Terrible, tsar of Russia, orders the massacre of inhabitants of Novgorod.

Title: Ternate
Blurb: Sultan Hairun of Ternate is killed by the Portuguese. Babullah becomes the next Sultan.

Title: Kingdom of Livonia
Blurb: The Kingdom of Livonia is established as a vassal state of Russia in some of its conquered lands in Livonia.

Title: Harrien-Wierland, Jerwen and Wiek
Blurb: Denmark cedes its nominal rights over Dago and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth cedes its nominal rights over Harrien-Wierland (including Reval), Jerwen and Wiek to Sweden.

Title: Fatehpur Sikri
Blurb: The Mughal Empire moves its capital from Agra to Fatehpur Sikri.

Title: Holy League
Blurb: Pope Pius V completes the Holy League as a united front against the Ottoman Turks, responding to the fall of Cyprus to the Ottomans.

Title: Lepanto
Blurb: The Spanish-led Holy League navy destroys the Ottoman navy at the Battle of Lepanto.

Title: Luzon Empire
Blurb: The Kingdom of Spain conquers the Luzon Empire.

Title: Manila
Blurb: Spanish conquistador Miguel Lopez de Legazpi establishes Manila, Philippines as the capital of the Spanish East Indies.

Title: Valletta
Blurb: The Order of Saint John moves the capital of Malta from Birgu to Valletta.

Title: Brielle
Blurb: Brielle is taken from Habsburg Spain by Protestant Watergeuzen in the Capture of Brielle, in the Eighty Years' War.

Title: Ming China
Blurb: The 9 years old Taizi, Zhu Yijun ascended the throne of Ming dynasty, known as Wanli Emperor.

Title: Paris
Blurb: Catherine de' Medici instigates the St. Bartholomew's Day massacre, which takes the lives of Protestant leader Gaspard de Coligny and thousands of Huguenots. The violence spreads from Paris to other cities and the countryside.

Title: Vilcabamba
Blurb: Spanish conquistadores apprehend the last Inca leader Tupak Amaru at Vilcabamba, Peru, and execute him in Cuzco.

Title: Danish Osel
Blurb: The Danish-controlled former Bishopric of Osel-Wiek is annexed as Danish Osel.

Title: Colony of Brazil
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal divides the Colony of Brazil into North Brazil, with its capital at Salvador, and South Brazil, with its capital at Rio de Janeiro.

Title: Cyprus
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire conquers the island of Cyprus from the Republic of Venice.

Title: Gujarat Sultanate
Blurb: The Gujarat Sultanate is annexed by the Mughal Empire.

Title: Haarlem
Blurb: After heavy losses on both sides the siege of Haarlem ends in a Spanish victory.

Title: Japan
Blurb: In Japan, the Azuchi-Momoyama period follows the Sengoku period.

Title: Leiden
Blurb: After a siege of 4 months the siege of Leiden ends in a comprehensive Dutch rebel victory.

Title: Middelburg
Blurb: In the Eighty Years' War the capital of Zeeland, Middelburg declares for the Protestants.

Title: Angola
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal establishes colonies on the coast of Angola.

Title: Nagashima
Blurb: Oda Nobunaga finally captures Nagashima fortress.

Title: Santiago
Blurb: The capital of Chile is moved from Concepcion to Santiago.

Title: Ternate
Blurb: Following a five-year war, the Ternateans under Sultan Babullah defeated the Portuguese.

Title: Antwerp
Blurb: Sack of Antwerp by badly paid Spanish soldiers.

Title: Bengal Sultanate
Blurb: The Bengal Sultanate is annexed by the Mughal Empire.

Title: Haldighati
Blurb: The Battle of Haldighati is fought between the ruler of Mewar, Maharana Pratap and the Mughal Empire's forces under Emperor Akbar led by Raja Man Singh.

Title: Adal Sultanate
Blurb: The Adal Sultanate is disestablished.

Title: Circumnavigation by Francis Drake
Blurb: Francis Drake circles the world, from 1577 to 1580.

Title: Kingdom of Livonia
Blurb: The Russian vassal state Kingdom of Livonia is disestablished.

Title: Alcazarquivir
Blurb: King Sebastian of Portugal is killed at the Battle of Alcazarquivir.

Title: Bishopric of Courland
Blurb: The Danish-controlled Bishopric of Courland becomes a vassal state of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.

Title: Brunei
Blurb: Governor-General Francisco de Sande officially declared war against Brunei in 1578, starting the Castilian War of 1578.

Title: Colony of Brazil
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal reunites North Brazil and South Brazil into the Colony of Brazil. The capital is Salvador.

Title: Tibet
Blurb: Sonam Gyatso is conferred the title of Dalai Lama by Tumed Mongol ruler, Altan Khan. Recognised as the reincarnation of two previous Lamas, Sonam Gyatso becomes the third Dalai Lama in the lineage.

Title: Tidore
Blurb: The Portuguese establish a fort on Tidore but the main centre for Portuguese activities in Maluku becomes Ambon.

Title: Duchy of the Archipelago
Blurb: The Duchy of the Archipelago is annexed by the Ottoman Empire.

Title: Union of Utrecht
Blurb: The Union of Utrecht unifies the northern Netherlands, a foundation for the later Dutch Republic.

Title: Iberian Union
Blurb: Spain unifies with Portugal under Philip II. The struggle for the throne of Portugal ends the Portuguese Empire. The Spanish and Portuguese crowns are united for 60 years, until 1640.

Title: Nagasaki
Blurb: Nagasaki comes under control of the Jesuits, from 1580 to 1587.

Title: Spanish Armada
Blurb: Drake's royal reception after his attacks on Spanish possessions influences Philip II of Spain to build up the Spanish Armada. English ships in Spanish harbours are impounded.

Title: Siberia
Blurb: Yermak Timofeyevich invades the territory of the Voguls, beginning the Russian conquest of Siberia.

Title: Dutch Republic
Blurb: Dutch Act of Abjuration, declaring abjuring allegiance to Philip II of Spain.

Title: Riga
Blurb: The Treaty of Drohiczyn cedes the free imperial city of Riga to the Polish-Lithuanian Duchy of Livonia.

Title: Seven United Netherlands
Blurb: The Republic of the Seven United Netherlands declares its independence from the Monarchy of Spain.

Title: Honno-ji
Blurb: Oda Nobunaga commits seppuku during the Honno-ji Incident coup by his general, Akechi Mitsuhide.

Title: Siberia Khanate
Blurb: Yermak Timofeyevich conquers the Siberia Khanate on behalf of the Stroganovs.

Title: Central and southern Livonia
Blurb: The Truce of Yam-Zapolsky cedes the Russian-controlled areas in former central and southern Livonia to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.

Title: Gregorian calendar
Blurb: Pope Gregory XIII issues the Gregorian calendar. The last day of the Julian calendar was Thursday, 4 October 1582 and this was followed by the first day of the Gregorian calendar, Friday, 15 October 1582.

Title: Bakken
Blurb: Denmark builds the world's first theme park, Bakken.

Title: Ternate
Blurb: Death of Sultan Babullah of Ternate.

Title: Livonia
Blurb: The Treaty of Plussa cedes all the remaining Russian-controlled areas in former Livonia to Sweden.

Title: Antwerp
Blurb: After the siege of Antwerp, many of its merchants flee to Amsterdam. At its peak, between 1510 and 1557, Antwerp concentrated about 40 percent of the world trade.

Title: Mataram
Blurb: Ki Ageng Pemanahan died. Sultan Pajang raised Sutawijaya, son of Ki Ageng Pemanahan as the new ruler in Mataram.

Title: Duchy of Estonia
Blurb: Areas under Swedish control in Northern Estonia are annexed as the Duchy of Estonia.

Title: Atlantic Ocean
Blurb: The Anglo-Spanish War is fought on both sides of the Atlantic, from 1585 to 1604.

Title: Courland
Blurb: The Treaty of Kronborg formally cedes the nominally Danish but Polish-Lithuanian-controlled former Bishopric of Courland to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.

Title: Kashmir
Blurb: Akbar annexes Kashmir and adds it to the Kabul Subah.

Title: Kingdom of Luba
Blurb: The Kingdom of Luba is established in central Africa.

Title: Roanoke
Blurb: Colony at Roanoke founded in North America.
Place: Roanoke Island, North Carolina, United States

Title: Lahore
Blurb: The Mughal Empire moves its capital from Fatehpur Sikri to Lahore. In the same year the capital is moved again to Agra.

Title: Portuguese Timor
Blurb: Portugal establishes the colony of Portuguese Timor.

Title: Kingdom of Scotland
Blurb: Mary, Queen of Scots is executed by Elizabeth I.

Title: Mataram Sultanate
Blurb: Troops that would invade Pajang Mataram Sultanate storm ravaged the eruption of Mount Merapi. Sutawijaya and his men survived.

Title: Safavid Iran
Blurb: The reign of Abbas I marks the zenith of the Safavid dynasty.

Title: England
Blurb: England repulses the Spanish Armada.

Title: Mataram Sultanate
Blurb: Mataram into the kingdom with Sutawijaya as Sultan, titled Senapati Ingalaga Sayidin Panatagama.

Title: Spain
Blurb: Spain repulses the English Armada.

Title: Eastern Anatolia and the Caucasus
Blurb: Through its victory in the Ottoman-Safavid War, the Ottoman Empire expands eastwards.

Title: Odawara
Blurb: Siege of Odawara: the Go-Hojo clan surrender to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Japan is unified.

Title: Moscow
Blurb: Gazi Giray leads a huge Tatar expedition against Moscow.

Title: Songhai Empire
Blurb: Fall of the Songhai Empire in West Africa.

Title: Tondibi
Blurb: In Mali, Moroccan forces of the Sultan Ahmad al-Mansur led by Judar Pasha defeat the Songhai Empire at the Battle of Tondibi.

Title: Korea
Blurb: Korea, with the help of Ming dynasty China, repels two Japanese invasions, from 1592 to 1598.

Title: Korean Peninsula
Blurb: Japan invades the Korean Peninsula under Toyotomi Hideyoshi with the aim of attacking the Ming dynasty of China.

Title: London
Blurb: John Stow reports 10,675 plague deaths in London, a city of approximately 200,000 people, from 1592 to 1593.

Title: Habsburg-Ottoman frontier
Blurb: The Long War between the Habsburg monarchy and the Ottoman Turks, from 1593 to 1606.

Title: Kandy
Blurb: Vimaladharmasuriya I moves the capital of the Sinhala Kingdom to Kandy, Sri Lanka.

Title: St. Paul's College, Macau
Blurb: St. Paul's College, Macau, founded by Alessandro Valignano.

Title: East Indies
Blurb: First Dutch expedition to Indonesia sets sail for the East Indies with two hundred and forty-nine men and sixty-four cannons led by Cornelis de Houtman.

Title: Svalbard
Blurb: Willem Barentsz makes the first indisputable discovery of the Svalbard archipelago.

Title: Banten
Blurb: De Houtman's expedition reaches Banten the main pepper port of West Java where they clash with both the Portuguese and Indonesians. It then sails east along the north coast of Java losing twelve crew to a Javanese attack at Sidayu and killing a local ruler in Madura.

Title: Duchy of Ferrara
Blurb: The Duchy of Ferrara becomes part of the Papal States.

Title: Netherlands
Blurb: Cornelis de Houtman's expedition returns to the Netherlands with enough spices to make a considerable profit.

Title: Isfahan
Blurb: Abbas I moves Safavids capital from Qazvin to Isfahan in 1598.

Title: Japan
Blurb: Death of Toyotomi Hideyoshi, known as the unifier of Japan.

Title: Korean Peninsula
Blurb: Japan withdraws from the Korean Peninsula after being pushed back by Chinese and Korean troops.

Title: Nantes
Blurb: The Edict of Nantes ends the French Wars of Religion.

Title: Russia
Blurb: Russia descends into anarchy during the Time of Troubles, from 1598 to 1613.

Title: Santa Fe de Nuevo Mexico
Blurb: The province of Santa Fe de Nuevo Mexico is established in Northern New Spain. The region would later become a territory of Mexico, the New Mexico Territory in the United States, and the US State of New Mexico.
Place: Santa Fe, New Mexico, United States

Title: Siberia
Blurb: Kuchum, Khan of Sibir, is killed in battle with Russian forces, thus completing the Russian conquest of Siberia.

Title: Solor
Blurb: The Portuguese require an armada of 90 ships to put down a Solorese uprising, lasting to 1599.

Title: Jenne
Blurb: The Mali Empire is defeated at the Battle of Jenne.

Title: Maluku Islands
Blurb: Leaving Europe the previous year, a fleet of eight ships under Jacob van Neck was the first Dutch fleet to reach the Spice Islands of Maluku.

Title: Ambon
Blurb: The Portuguese win a major naval battle in the bay of Ambon. Later in the year, the Dutch join forces with the local Hituese in an anti-Portuguese alliance, in return for which the Dutch would have the sole right to purchase spices from Hitu.

Title: British East India Company
Blurb: Elizabeth I grants a charter to the British East India Company beginning the English advance in Asia.

Title: Rome
Blurb: Giordano Bruno is burned at the stake for heresy in Rome.

Title: Sekigahara
Blurb: Battle of Sekigahara in Japan. End of the Warring States period and beginning of the Edo period.

Title: Wallachia, Moldavia and Transylvania
Blurb: Michael the Brave unifies the three principalities: Wallachia, Moldavia and Transylvania after the Battle of Selimbar from 1599.

Title: Kinsale
Blurb: 4th Spanish Armada; in the Battle of Kinsale, England defeats Irish and Spanish forces, driving the Gaelic aristocracy out of Ireland and destroying the Gaelic clan system.

Title: Russia
Blurb: The Russian famine of 1601-1603 kills perhaps one-third of Russia.

Title: Bresse, Bugey and Gex
Blurb: France gains Bresse, Bugey, and Gex from Savoy, and cedes Saluzzo to Savoy in exchange.

Title: Dutch East India Company
Blurb: The Dutch East India Company (VOC) is established by merging competing Dutch trading companies. Its success contributes to the Dutch Golden Age.

Title: Map of the Myriad Countries of the World
Blurb: Matteo Ricci produces the Map of the Myriad Countries of the World, a world map that will be used throughout East Asia for centuries.

Title: Edo
Blurb: Tokugawa Ieyasu establishes the Tokugawa shogunate in Japan, which follows the Azuchi-Momoyama period. Edo is the capital.

Title: Nagasaki
Blurb: In Nagasaki, the Portuguese Jesuit missionary Joao Rodrigues publishes Nippo Jisho, the first dictionary of Japanese to a European (Portuguese) language.

Title: Union of the Crowns
Blurb: Elizabeth I of England dies and is succeeded by her cousin King James VI of Scotland, uniting the crowns of Scotland and England.

Title: Milky Way
Blurb: Supernova SN 1604 is observed in the Milky Way.

Title: Kepler's laws
Blurb: Johannes Kepler starts investigating elliptical orbits of planets.

Title: Kingdom of Gowa
Blurb: The King of Gowa, a Makassarese kingdom in South Sulawesi, converts to Islam.

Title: Mughal Empire
Blurb: The reign of Mughal emperor Jahangir after the death of emperor Akbar, from 1605 to 1627.

Title: Australia
Blurb: Willem Janszoon captained the first recorded European landing on the Australian continent, sailing from Bantam, Java, in the Duyfken.

Title: Royal Hungary
Blurb: Treaty of Vienna ends an anti-Habsburg uprising in Royal Hungary.

Title: Transylvania
Blurb: The Long Turkish War between the Ottoman Empire and Austria is ended with the Peace of Zsitvatorok. Austria abandons Transylvania.

Title: Aceh Sultanate
Blurb: Iskandar Muda becomes the Sultan of Aceh for 30 years. He will launch a series of naval conquests that will transform Aceh into a great power in the western Malay Archipelago.

Title: Jamestown
Blurb: The Jamestown establishment.

Title: Ulster
Blurb: Flight of the Earls (the fleeing of most of the native Gaelic aristocracy) occurs from County Donegal in the west of Ulster in Ireland.

Title: Colony of Brazil
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal divides the Colony of Brazil into North Brazil, with its capital at Salvador, and South Brazil, with its capital at Rio de Janeiro, for the second time.

Title: Protestant Union
Blurb: The Protestant Union is founded in the Holy Roman Empire.

Title: Quebec City
Blurb: Quebec City is founded as the capital of New France.

Title: Ryukyu Kingdom
Blurb: The Ryukyu Kingdom becomes a vassal state of the Tokugawa shogunate.

Title: Catholic League
Blurb: The Catholic League is founded in the Holy Roman Empire.

Title: Hudson Bay
Blurb: Henry Hudson discovers Hudson Bay.

Title: Jupiter
Blurb: Galileo Galilei and Simon Marius observe Jupiter's Galilean moons.

Title: Kingdom of France
Blurb: King Henry IV of France is assassinated by Francois Ravaillac.

Title: Moscow
Blurb: The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth army defeats combined Russian-Swedish forces at the Battle of Klushino and conquers Moscow.

Title: Newfoundland Colony
Blurb: England establishes the Newfoundland Colony in North America.

Title: Orion Nebula
Blurb: The Orion Nebula is identified by Nicolas-Claude Fabri de Peiresc of France.

Title: King James Bible
Blurb: The first publication of the King James Bible, also known as the Authorized Version.

Title: University of Santo Tomas
Blurb: The Pontifical and Royal University of Santo Tomas, the oldest existing university in Asia, is established by the Dominican Order in Manila.

Title: Colony of Brazil
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal reunites North Brazil and South Brazil into the Colony of Brazil. The capital is Salvador.

Title: Cotswolds
Blurb: The first Cotswold Olympic Games, an annual public celebration of games and sports begins in the Cotswolds, England.

Title: Flintlock musket
Blurb: The first flintlock musket likely created for Louis XIII of France by gunsmith Marin Bourgeois.

Title: House of Romanov
Blurb: The Time of Troubles in Russia ends with the establishment of the House of Romanov, which rules until 1917.

Title: Jepara
Blurb: The Dutch East India Company is forced to evacuate Gresik due to the Mataram siege in neighboring Surabaya. The Dutch negotiates with Mataram and is allowed to set up a trading post in Jepara.

Title: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth
Blurb: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth is invaded by the Tatars dozens of times, from 1613 to 1617.

Title: Cacheu
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal establishes the colony of Cacheu in what is now Guinea-Bissau.

Title: Logarithm
Blurb: John Napier introduces the logarithm to simplify calculations.

Title: Osaka
Blurb: The Siege of Osaka, the last major threat to Tokugawa shogunate, ends.

Title: Reflecting telescope
Blurb: Niccolo Zucchi describes experiments with a bronze parabolic mirror trying to make a reflecting telescope.

Title: Spain
Blurb: The last remaining Moriscos (Moors who had nominally converted to Christianity) in Spain are expelled.

Title: Later Jin dynasty
Blurb: Taizu establishes the Later Jin dynasty in China.

Title: Kexholm and Ingria
Blurb: In the Treaty of Stolbovo, Sweden gains the Russian province and fortress of Kexholm (now Priozersk) and the province of Ingria including the fortress of Noteborg (now Shlisselburg, Russia).

Title: Bishopric of Courland
Blurb: The Polish-Lithuanian vassal state Bishopric of Courland comes into personal union with Poland-Lithuania.

Title: Bohemia
Blurb: The Bohemian Revolt precipitates the Thirty Years' War, which devastates Europe in the years 1618 to 1648.

Title: Ming China
Blurb: The Manchus start invading China. Their conquest eventually topples the Ming dynasty.

Title: Brandenburg-Prussia
Blurb: The personal union of the Electorate of Brandenburg with the Duchy of Prussia creates Brandenburg-Prussia. Berlin and Konigsberg are the respective capitals.

Title: Batavia
Blurb: The Dutch East India Company storms Jayakarta and withstands a months-long siege by combined English, Bantenese and Jayakartan forces until relieved by Jan Pieterszoon Coen. The Dutch destroy Jayakarta and build their headquarters, Batavia, on the site.

Title: Virginia
Blurb: European slaving reaches America when the first Africans are brought to the present-day United States.

Title: Cecora
Blurb: Bethlen Gabor allies with the Ottomans and an invasion of Moldavia takes place. The Polish suffer a disaster at Cecora on the River Prut.

Title: Danish India
Blurb: The Danish East India Company establishes the colony of Danish India.

Title: Kasanje Kingdom
Blurb: The Kasanje Kingdom is founded in central Africa.

Title: Moldavia
Blurb: Polish-Ottoman War over Moldavia, from 1620 to 1621.

Title: Plymouth Colony
Blurb: The Mayflower sets sail from Plymouth, England to what became the Plymouth Colony in New England.

Title: Submarine
Blurb: Cornelis Drebbel, funded by James I of England, builds the first submarine made of wood and greased leather.

Title: Chocim
Blurb: The Battle of Chocim: Poles and Cossacks under Jan Karol Chodkiewicz defeat the Ottomans.

Title: Dutch West India Company
Blurb: The Dutch West India Company is founded.

Title: State of Brazil and State of Maranhao
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal divides the Colony of Brazil into the State of Brazil and the State of Maranhao. The capitals are Salvador and Sao Luis, respectively.

Title: Nova Scotia
Blurb: Nova Scotia is founded as a colony of the Kingdom of Scotland.

Title: Jamestown
Blurb: Jamestown massacre: Algonquian natives kill 347 English settlers outside Jamestown, Virginia (approximately one-third of the colony's population) and burn the Henricus settlement.

Title: Electorate of Bavaria
Blurb: The Electorate of Bavaria emerges from the Duchy of Bavaria. Munich remains the capital.

Title: English Dictionarie
Blurb: The third English dictionary, English Dictionarie, is published by Henry Cockeram, listing difficult words with definitions.

Title: Dutch Formosa
Blurb: The colony of Dutch Formosa is established on Taiwan.

Title: Kingdom of France
Blurb: As chief minister, Cardinal Richelieu centralises power in France, from 1624 to 1642.

Title: New Netherland
Blurb: The colony of New Netherland is established in North America.

Title: New Amsterdam
Blurb: The Dutch purchase the island of Manhattan and found New Amsterdam, which later becomes New York City.

Title: St. Peter's Basilica
Blurb: St. Peter's Basilica in the Vatican completed.

Title: Aurochs
Blurb: Aurochs go extinct.

Title: Barbados
Blurb: The Kingdom of England colonizes Barbados, with its capital at Saint James Town.

Title: Batavia
Blurb: Sultan Agung of Mataram launches a failed campaign to conquer Dutch Batavia, from 1628 to 1629.

Title: Circulatory system
Blurb: William Harvey publishes and elucidates his earlier discovery of the circulatory system.

Title: Carolina Colony
Blurb: The Carolina Colony is founded in North America.

Title: Holy Roman Empire
Blurb: Cardinal Richelieu allies with Swedish Protestant forces in the Thirty Years' War to counter Ferdinand II's expansion.

Title: Massachusetts Bay Colony
Blurb: The Massachusetts Bay Colony is founded in North America.

Title: New Hampshire Colony
Blurb: The New Hampshire Colony is founded in North America.

Title: Safavid Iran
Blurb: Abbas I, the Safavid king, died.

Title: Duchy of Pomerania
Blurb: Sweden occupies the Duchy of Pomerania.

Title: Dutch Brazil
Blurb: The Dutch establish the colony of Dutch Brazil. The capital is Mauritsstad (now Recife).

Title: Kingdom of Matamba
Blurb: The Kingdom of Matamba is established in southwest Africa.

Title: Mount Vesuvius
Blurb: Mount Vesuvius erupts.

Title: Antigua
Blurb: The Kingdom of England colonizes Antigua.

Title: Lutzen
Blurb: Battle of Lutzen, death of king of Sweden Gustav II Adolf.

Title: Maryland Colony
Blurb: The Maryland Colony is founded. St. Mary's City is the capital.

Title: Taj Mahal
Blurb: Taj Mahal building work started in Agra, India.

Title: Japan
Blurb: Japan transforms into a locked country, from 1633 to 1639.

Title: Rome
Blurb: Galileo Galilei arrives in Rome for his trial before the Inquisition.

Title: Nordlingen
Blurb: Battle of Nordlingen results in Catholic victory.

Title: Guadeloupe and Martinique

Blurb: The Saybrook Colony is founded in what is now the U.S. state of Connecticut. Old Saybrook is the capital.

Title: Harvard University
Blurb: Harvard University is founded in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

Title: Connecticut Colony
Blurb: The Connecticut Colony is founded in North America. Hartford is the capital.

Title: Fermat's Last Theorem
Blurb: Pierre de Fermat formulates his so-called Last Theorem, unsolved until 1995.

Title: Joseon
Blurb: Joseon becomes a tributary state of the Qing dynasty after the invasion of Korea.

Title: Shimabara
Blurb: Shimabara Rebellion of Japanese Christians, ronin and peasants against Edo.

Title: Teatro San Cassiano
Blurb: Teatro San Cassiano, the first public opera house, opened in Venice.

Title: Tian Gong Kai Wu
Blurb: Although Chinese naval mines were earlier described in the 14th century Huolongjing, the Tian Gong Kai Wu book of Ming dynasty scholar Song Yingxing describes naval mines wrapped in a lacquer bag and ignited by an ambusher pulling a rip cord on the nearby shore.

Title: Mauritius
Blurb: The Dutch East India Company takes possession of Mauritius.

Title: New Sweden
Blurb: The colony of New Sweden is established in North America.

Title: Castro
Blurb: Disagreements between the Farnese and Barberini Pope Urban VIII escalate into the Wars of Castro and last until 1649.

Title: Scotland, Ireland and England
Blurb: Wars of the Three Kingdoms, civil wars throughout Scotland, Ireland, and England, from 1639 to 1651.

Title: The Downs
Blurb: Naval Battle of the Downs: Republic of the United Provinces fleet decisively defeats a Spanish fleet in English waters.

Title: Emirate of Trarza
Blurb: The Emirate of Trarza is established in North Africa.

Title: Iberian Union
Blurb: The Portuguese Restoration War led to the end of the Iberian Union, from 1640 to 1668.

Title: Ireland
Blurb: The Irish Rebellion, by Irish Catholics who wanted an end to discrimination, greater self-governance, and reverse ownership of the plantations of Ireland.

Title: Malacca, Annobon and Angola
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal loses Malacca, Annobon, and Angola to the Republic of the Seven United Provinces.

Title: England
Blurb: Beginning of English Civil War, conflict will end in 1649 with the execution of King Charles I, the abolition of the monarchy and the establishment of the supremacy of Parliament over the king.

Title: Mauritania
Blurb: The Mauritanian Thirty-Year War, from 1644 to 1674.

Title: Qing China
Blurb: The Manchu conquer China ending the Ming dynasty. The subsequent Qing dynasty rules until 1912.

Title: Saybrook Colony
Blurb: The Saybrook Colony is sold to the Connecticut Colony.

Title: Southern Ming dynasty
Blurb: Hongguang establishes the Southern Ming dynasty in China.

Title: Beijing
Blurb: The Qing dynasty supersedes the Ming dynasty as the legitimate dynasty of China. Beijing is the capital.

Title: Crete
Blurb: Ottoman war with Venice. The Ottomans invade Crete and capture Canea. The war lasts to 1669.

Title: Rotating stage
Blurb: Giacomo Torelli of Venice, Italy invents the first rotating stage.

Title: Jamtland, Harjedalen, Gotland, Osel and Halland
Blurb: The Kingdom of Denmark and Norway, the Wends and the Goths cedes Jamtland, Harjedalen, Idre and Sarna, Gotland, Osel, and Halland, the latter for a period of 30 years, to the Kingdom of Sweden as part of the Treaty of Bromsebro.

Title: Vijayanagara Empire
Blurb: The Vijayanagara Empire is dissolved.

Title: Seville
Blurb: The Great Plague of Seville, from 1647 to 1652.

Title: Alsace and Pignerol
Blurb: France receives the cities of the Decapole in Alsace (except Strasbourg, the Diocese of Strasbourg, and Mulhouse) and the city of Pignerol from the Spanish Duchy of Milan (Peace of Westphalia).

Title: Angola
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal takes back Angola from the Republic of the Seven United Provinces.

Title: Bahamas
Blurb: The Kingdom of England colonizes the Bahamas.

Title: Candia
Blurb: The Ottomans capture Crete from the Venetians after the Siege of Candia, from 1648 to 1669.

Title: Delhi
Blurb: The Mughal Empire moves its capital from Agra to Delhi.

Title: Duchy of Pomerania
Blurb: The Duchy of Pomerania is divided between Sweden (Swedish Pomerania) and Brandenburg-Prussia (Farther Pomerania), although the precise borders would not be determined until 1653 (Peace of Westphalia).

Title: France
Blurb: Fronde civil war in France, from 1648 to 1653.

Title: Holy Roman Empire
Blurb: The Thirty Years' War ends with the Peace of Westphalia.

Title: Netherlands, Switzerland and the Italian city-states
Blurb: The Netherlands, Switzerland, and many Italian city-states are made independent of the Holy Roman Empire (Peace of Westphalia).

Title: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth
Blurb: The Deluge wars leave Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in ruins, from 1648 to 1667.

Title: Ukraine
Blurb: The Khmelnytsky Uprising, a Cossack rebellion in Ukraine which turned into a Ukrainian war of liberation from Poland, from 1648 to 1657.

Title: Grenada
Blurb: Grenada is acquired by the Kingdom of France.

Title: Ireland
Blurb: The Cromwellian conquest of Ireland, from 1649 to 1653.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: King Charles I is executed for high treason, the first and only English king to be subjected to legal proceedings in a High Court of Justice and put to death.

Title: Anguilla
Blurb: The Commonwealth of England colonizes Anguilla with settlers from Saint Kitts.

Title: Lunar maria
Blurb: Giovanni Riccioli renames the lunar maria.

Title: Worcester
Blurb: English Civil War ends with the Parliamentarian victory at the Battle of Worcester.

Title: Swedish Pomerania and Farther Pomerania
Blurb: The precise borders between Swedish Pomerania and Farther Pomerania (Brandenburg-Prussia) are determined by the Treaty of Stettin.

Title: Dutch Brazil
Blurb: During the Dutch-Portuguese War, the Kingdom of Portugal conquers the colony of Dutch Brazil from the Republic of the Seven United Provinces.

Title: New Sweden
Blurb: The colony of New Sweden falls to the Dutch.

Title: Sweden
Blurb: The Northern Wars cement Sweden's rise as a Great Power, from 1655 to 1661.

Title: Bishopric of Courland
Blurb: The former Bishopric of Courland, until then in personal union with the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, is sold to the Polish-Lithuanian vassal state Duchy of Courland and Semigallia and becomes its vassal state instead.

Title: Ottoman Empire
Blurb: Mehmed Koprulu is Grand Vizier, from 1656 to 1661.

Title: Rings of Saturn
Blurb: Christiaan Huygens describes the true shape of the rings of Saturn.

Title: Duchy of Prussia
Blurb: The Treaty of Bromberg gives the Duchy of Prussia its sovereignty.

Title: Mughal Empire
Blurb: After his father Shah Jahan completes the Taj Mahal, his son Aurangzeb deposes him as ruler of the Mughal Empire.

Title: Portuguese Ceylon
Blurb: During the Dutch-Portuguese War, the Dutch gain control of Portuguese-held possessions in Sri Lanka from the Kingdom of Portugal.

Title: Skane, Blekinge, Halland, Bornholm, Bahus and Trondelag
Blurb: Denmark-Norway cedes Skane, Blekinge, Halland, Bornholm, Bahus, and Trondelag to the Kingdom of Sweden as part of the Treaty of Roskilde.

Title: Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland
Blurb: The Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland supersedes the Commonwealth of England, the Kingdom of Scotland, and the Kingdom of Ireland. Edinburgh and Dublin yield to London as the capital.

Title: Artois, Roussillon and Perpignan
Blurb: Treaty of the Pyrenees: Artois, Roussillon, and Perpignan are annexed by the Kingdom of France.

Title: Mars
Blurb: Christiaan Huygens first to observe surface details of Mars.

Title: Saadi dynasty
Blurb: Fall of the Saadi dynasty in Morocco.

Title: Saint Helena
Blurb: The British East India Company takes possession of Saint Helena.

Title: Pratapgad
Blurb: King Shivaji killed Adil Shahi dynasty's general Afzal Khan at Pratapgad fort on 9 November.

Title: Brunei
Blurb: The Bruneian Civil War begins.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: The Commonwealth of England ends and the monarchy is brought back during the English Restoration.

Title: Royal Society
Blurb: The Royal Society is founded.

Title: England, Scotland and Ireland
Blurb: The restored Kingdom of England, Kingdom of Scotland, and Kingdom of Ireland supersede the republican Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland. London, Edinburgh, and Dublin are the respective capitals.

Title: Runo Island
Blurb: The Treaty of Oliva cedes Runo Island in Estonia from the Polish-Lithuanian vassal state Duchy of Courland and Semigallia to Sweden.

Title: Trondelag and Bornholm
Blurb: The Kingdom of Sweden cedes Trondelag and Bornholm to Denmark-Norway as part of the Treaty of Copenhagen.

Title: Bombay
Blurb: Portuguese India cedes the port of Bombay to the British as dowry to King Charles II of England.

Title: Qing China
Blurb: The reign of the Kangxi Emperor of China begins.

Title: Tangier
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal hands Tangier over to the Kingdom of England as a dowry.

Title: Bishopric of Courland
Blurb: The former Bishopric of Courland, a vassal state of the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia (itself a vassal state of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth), comes into personal union with Courland and Semigallia.

Title: Dutch Formosa
Blurb: Dutch Formosa is conquered by the Southern Ming dynasty.

Title: Southern Ming dynasty
Blurb: The Southern Ming dynasty ends with the conquest by the Qing dynasty.

Title: Sparkling wine
Blurb: Christopher Merret presents first paper on the production of sparkling wine.

Title: Gregorian telescope
Blurb: James Gregory publishes designs for a reflecting telescope.

Title: Habsburg Hungary
Blurb: Ottoman war against Habsburg Hungary.

Title: Massa
Blurb: The Duchy of Massa and Carrara is established. Massa is the capital.

Title: Alawi dynasty
Blurb: The Alawi dynasty is established in Morocco.

Title: Delaware Colony
Blurb: The Delaware Colony is founded in North America. New Castle is the capital.

Title: French East India Company
Blurb: The French East India Company is founded.

Title: New Haven Colony
Blurb: The New Haven Colony is merged into the Connecticut Colony.

Title: New Jersey Colony
Blurb: The New Jersey Colony is founded in North America.

Title: New Netherland
Blurb: The Dutch Republic signs the Treaty of Breda, which cedes New Netherland to the Kingdom of England.

Title: New York Colony
Blurb: The New York Colony is founded in North America. New York City is the capital.

Title: St. Gotthard
Blurb: The Battle of St. Gotthard: count Raimondo Montecuccoli defeats the Ottomans. The Peace of Vasvar is intended to keep the peace for 20 years.

Title: Cell
Blurb: Robert Hooke discovers cells using a microscope.

Title: Colony of Jamaica
Blurb: The Kingdom of England establishes the Colony of Jamaica. Spanish Town is the capital.

Title: Mbwila
Blurb: Portugal defeats the Kongo Empire at the Battle of Mbwila.

Title: North Sea
Blurb: The Second Anglo-Dutch War fought between England and the United Provinces, from 1665 to 1667.

Title: Purandar
Blurb: Maratha King Shivaji signed the Treaty of Purandar with Mughal general Jai Singh I after Battle of Purandar.

Title: Agra Fort
Blurb: Shivaji visited Aurangzeb at Agra Fort and forced him into house arrest. Shivaji later escaped and returned to the Maratha kingdom.

Title: Anguilla
Blurb: The Kingdom of France conquers Anguilla from the Kingdom of England.

Title: Khanate of Kalat
Blurb: The Khanate of Kalat is established.

Title: London
Blurb: The Great Fire of London.

Title: Medway
Blurb: The Raid on the Medway during the Second Anglo-Dutch War.

Title: Ottoman Europe
Blurb: The Great Turkish War halts the Ottoman Empire's expansion into Europe, from 1667 to 1699.

Title: Spanish Netherlands
Blurb: The War of Devolution: France invades the Netherlands. The Peace of Aix-la-Chapelle (1668) brings this to a halt.

Title: Left-Bank Ukraine, Kyiv and Smolensk
Blurb: The Truce of Andrusovo. Left-Bank Ukraine, Kyiv, and Smolensk is given to the Russian Tsardom. Poland-Lithuania was left with Right-Bank Ukraine, and Russian-occupied Belarus with Vitebsk, Polotsk, and Dzwinsk. Zaporizhzhia was recognized as a condominium of both states.

Title: Anguilla
Blurb: The Kingdom of France returns Anguilla to the Kingdom of England according to the Treaty of Breda.

Title: Lille, Douai, Tournai and Kortrijk
Blurb: The Kingdom of France acquires Armentieres, Bergues, Charleroi, Kortrijk, Douai, Veurne, Lille, Oudenaarde and Tournai (Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle).

Title: Dutch Republic
Blurb: Franco-Dutch War, from 1672 to 1678. French invasion of the Netherlands, which Louis XIV initiated in 1672.

Title: Khotyn
Blurb: Ottoman campaign to help the Ukrainian Cossacks. John Sobieski defeats the Ottomans at the second battle of Khotyn (1673).

Title: North Sea
Blurb: The Third Anglo-Dutch War fought between England and the United Provinces, from 1672 to 1674.

Title: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth
Blurb: Polish-Ottoman War, from 1672 to 1676.

Title: Brunei
Blurb: The Bruneian Civil War ends with Muhiyiddin winning the war.

Title: Puducherry
Blurb: The Kingdom of France acquires Puducherry.

Title: Maratha Empire
Blurb: Shivaji founded the Maratha Empire and crowned himself as first Chatrapati of the empire.

Title: Bacteria
Blurb: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek discovers Bacteria.

Title: Ottoman Empire
Blurb: Russia and the Ottoman Empire commence the Russo-Turkish Wars, from 1676 to 1681.

Title: Podolia and central Ukraine
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire gains parts of Podolia and parts of Central Ukraine from Poland-Lithuania.

Title: Speed of light
Blurb: First measurement of the speed of light.

Title: Mac dynasty
Blurb: The Mac dynasty of Vietnam collapses.

Title: Nijmegen
Blurb: The Treaty of Nijmegen ends various interconnected wars among France, the Dutch Republic, Spain, Brandenburg, Sweden, Denmark, the Prince-Bishopric of Munster, and the Holy Roman Empire.

Title: Franche-Comte, Ypres and Valenciennes
Blurb: The Treaty of Nijmegen is signed. Spain gives Franche-Comte, Ypres, Maubeuge, Cateau-Cambresis, Valenciennes, Saint-Omer and Cassel to France and France restores Charleroi and Philippsburg.

Title: Binary system
Blurb: Binary system developed by Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz.

Title: Kingdom of Burundi
Blurb: The Kingdom of Burundi is established.

Title: New Mexico
Blurb: The Pueblo Revolt drives the Spanish out of New Mexico until 1692.
Place: Santa Fe, New Mexico, United States

Title: Maratha Empire
Blurb: Prince Sambhaji crowned himself as the second Chatrapati of Maratha Empire 20 July.

Title: Pennsylvania Colony
Blurb: The Pennsylvania Colony is founded in North America. Philadelphia is the capital.

Title: Louisiana
Blurb: French explorer Robert La Salle claims all the land east of the Mississippi River.

Title: Ottoman Hungary
Blurb: The Great Turkish War leads to the conquest of most of Ottoman Hungary by the Habsburgs, from 1683 to 1699.

Title: Taiwan
Blurb: China conquers the Kingdom of Tungning and annexes Taiwan.

Title: Vienna
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire is defeated in the second Siege of Vienna.

Title: Bermuda
Blurb: The English Crown Colony of Bermuda supersedes the Somers Isles Company. Hamilton is the capital.

Title: Calculus
Blurb: Calculus independently developed by both Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz and Sir Isaac Newton and used to formulate classical mechanics.

Title: Tangier
Blurb: The Kingdom of England hands Tangier over to the Alawi dynasty.

Title: Barbuda
Blurb: The Kingdom of England colonizes Barbuda.

Title: Kiev and Zaporizhzhia
Blurb: The Russian Tsardom gains Kiev and Zaporizhzhia from Poland-Lithuania by the Treaty of Eternal Peace.

Title: Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica
Blurb: Isaac Newton publishes Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica.

Title: Ayutthaya Kingdom
Blurb: Siamese revolution of 1688 ousted French influence and virtually severed all ties with the West until the 19th century.

Title: Derry
Blurb: The Siege of Derry, the first major event in the Williamite War in Ireland.

Title: Grand Alliance
Blurb: The Grand Alliance sought to stop French expansion during the Nine Years' War, from 1688 to 1697.

Title: Ireland
Blurb: The War of the Two Kings in Ireland, from 1688 to 1691.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: The Glorious Revolution starts with the Dutch Republic invading England, England becomes a constitutional monarchy, from 1688 to 1689.

Title: Amur River frontier
Blurb: The Treaty of Nerchinsk is signed between the Tsardom of Russia and the Qing Dynasty. Russia gives up the area north of the Amur River as far as the Stanovoy Range and keeps the area between the Argun River and Lake Baikal.

Title: Killiecrankie
Blurb: The Battle of Killiecrankie is fought between Jacobite and Williamite forces in Highland Perthshire.

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: Bill of Rights gains royal consent.

Title: Ludlow
Blurb: Wales ceases to have an official or administrative capital when Ludlow ceases to be the administrative capital following the end of the Council of Wales and the Marches.

Title: Skopje
Blurb: The Karposh rebellion is crushed in present-day North Macedonia, Skopje is retaken by the Ottoman Turks. Karposh is killed, and the rebels are defeated.

Title: Two Treatises of Government
Blurb: John Locke publishes Two Treatises of Government and A Letter Concerning Toleration.

Title: Boyne
Blurb: The Battle of the Boyne in Ireland.

Title: Electorate of Hanover
Blurb: The Electorate of Hanover is established. Hanover is the capital.

Title: France
Blurb: Famine in France kills two million, from 1692 to 1694.

Title: Port Royal
Blurb: Port Royal in Jamaica is struck by an earthquake and a tsunami. Approximately 2,000 people die and 2,300 are injured.

Title: Province of Massachusetts Bay
Blurb: The Massachusetts Bay Colony and Plymouth Colony are reorganized as the Province of Massachusetts Bay.

Title: College of William & Mary
Blurb: College of William & Mary is founded in Williamsburg, Virginia, by a royal charter.

Title: Bank of England
Blurb: The Bank of England is established.

Title: Annapolis
Blurb: The capital of Maryland Colony is moved from St. Mary's City to Annapolis.

Title: Mughal Empire
Blurb: The Mughal Empire nearly bans the East India Company in response to pirate Henry Every's capture of the trading ship Ganj-i-Sawai.

Title: Finland
Blurb: Famine in Finland wipes out almost one-third of the population, from 1696 to 1697.

Title: Holy Roman Empire
Blurb: The Kingdom of France hands over territories to the Holy Roman Empire (Peace of Ryswijk).

Title: Kingdom of England
Blurb: The Kingdom of France recognizes the Kingdom of England (Peace of Ryswijk).

Title: Saint-Domingue
Blurb: The western half of the colony of Santo Domingo (Kingdom of Spain) on the island of Hispaniola is recognised as the colony of Saint-Domingue of the Kingdom of France (Peace of Ryswijk).

Title: Saxony and Poland-Lithuania
Blurb: A personal union is established between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.

Title: Western Europe
Blurb: Grand Embassy of Peter the Great to Western Europe, from 1697 to 1699.

Title: Karlowitz
Blurb: The Treaty of Karlowitz ceded most of Hungary to the Habsburgs, the first major surrender of Ottoman territory in Europe.

Title: Morea and Dalmatia
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire cedes Morea and most of Dalmatia to the Republic of Venice (Treaty of Karlowitz).

Title: Podolia
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire returns Podolia to Poland-Lithuania (Treaty of Karlowitz).

Title: Principality of Transylvania
Blurb: The Principality of Transylvania, while nominally independent, becomes de facto under Habsburg rule (Treaty of Karlowitz).
